title: Saga University — claimed by thegentlemen
description: JP · Education · saga-u.ac.jp Saga University is a national Japanese university in Saga Prefecture, Kyushu — founded in 1949 (roots back to 1875), merged with Saga Medical School in 2003, operating as a national university corporation since 2004. Scale: ~6,600 students, ~3,300 staff, 6 faculties (including medicine with a ~600-bed hospital) across Honjo, Nabeshima, and Arita campuses. Annual revenue ¥44B ($300M),
